$comment: Python injection grammar. Gives dedicated scopes to Odoo constructs that the built-in grammar (MagicPython) does not distinguish: ORM class attributes (_name, _inherit, ...) and fields.* / models.* references.

orm-attribute.comment: ORM attribute assigned at the start of a line: `_inherit = 'sale.order'`.

odoo-type-call.comment: Call `fields.Char(...)` / `models.Model(...)`. Reuses MagicPython's argument rules so keyword arguments keep their highlighting.
odoo-type-call.name: meta.function-call.odoo.python

odoo-type-ref.comment: Reference without a call: `class X(models.Model)`, `isinstance(f, fields.Many2one)`, `fields.Command.create`.
